capabilities: Filter blocks across the vault by tags, text patterns, links, and block type
Display matching blocks from multiple notes in one Bases view
Check off tasks directly in the view without opening notes
Build vault-wide collections of quotes, logs, or code snippets
Configure styles via the Style Settings plugin
extras: Docs include example Bases snippets for daily logs, project tasks, code snippets, and quotes; installable from the official community plugins store; not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Block View is an extension for the Bases core plugin
problem: Bases views work at the file level, so there is no built-in way to list and filter individual content blocks from many notes in one place.

relations.evidence: Block View supports configuring some of the styles via the Style Settings plugin.

summary: A Bases view plugin that filters and displays blocks (paragraphs, tasks, quotes, code blocks) from notes across the vault as a database.
